items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: We played orchestration, and the biggest arrangement we had was Ted Lewis's arrangements. We used to play all the Ted Lewis arrangements.

ctx.x: Well, did y'all have arrangements in that band, written arrangements? Yeah.
We played orchestration, and the biggest arrangement we had was Ted Lewis's arrangements. We used to play all the Ted Lewis arrangements.
Would you play those by head, or would you go out and buy them?
